title: SDK Adoption Accelerator: structured output, streaming, and function-calling sample kit + release orchestration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a lightweight, production-oriented sample kit and release orchestration for SDK + API surfaces that demonstrates function calling, structured output schemas, and streaming in real-world client patterns. The goal is to accelerate adoption by providing runnable samples, a short prescriptive migration guide, and coordinated release notes and comms for SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) and API changelog entries.
acceptance_criteria: Runnable sample repo with examples for: sync generation -> structured JSON output; streaming tokens + chunked JSON assembly; and function-calling end-to-end flow
Updated SDK docs and quickstart snippets in the docs site for Python/TS/Go showing parameter examples and expected JSON schemas
Draft release notes for hosted API + SDK changelog entries + one-page migration guide
Cross-team signoff from Docs, DevEx, Design, and Runtime engineering on compatibility and examples
Telemetry hooks in Console to validate sample usage during beta (dashboards showing requests by sample route)

release_notes_draft: Highlights: stable SDK helpers for structured output parsing; built-in streaming helper for chunk assembly; function-calling end-to-end sample with schema validation. Breaking changes: none. Migration notes: add 'parseStructuredResponse' helper or use the recommended schema in examples.
rollout_plan_summary: 1) Internal beta: samples + docs behind feature flag for internal users (2 weeks). 2) Limited public beta: release SDK patch to early adopters and publish sample repo (1 week). 3) GA: include samples in official SDK release notes and docs site, marketing assets, and Console examples (target date aligns with sdk-2025.11 release).
mitigations: If streaming reassembly has edge cases with partial JSON, include a robust chunk-validator in samples and add unit tests
If function-calling introduces ambiguous schema versions, tie examples to explicit schema versioning and show how to validate
If telemetry route rollout is delayed, use a soft-launch and collect usage via a dedicated sample route parameter instead
outreach_playbook: Pre-launch email to early adopters: subject: 'Try the new SDK streaming & function-calling samples' - include links and migration bullet points
Launch day social + blog: 90-second demo GIF and code snippets highlighting streaming token assembly and function-calling flow
Post-launch follow-up: two-week feedback survey and invite to a short office hours session for integration questions
